name: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and distribution of medicines in the People's Republic of China. The company offers donafenib tosylate tablets for liver cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and metastatic radioactive iodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer; and recombinant human thrombin for hemostasis.
